final: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(1.0 * li.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(li.derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_ratio, COUNT(li.invoice_number) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number LIMIT 10
